        <script><![CDATA[/**
 * Inter-Warehouse Stock Transfer Processor
 *
 * IIFE script for the async Business Rule on inv_req.
 * Triggered when request_type=inventory_transfer and status changes to in_progress.
 *
 * - Does NOT modify available_quantity directly; modifies total_quantity
 *   and lets the existing "Calculate Available Qty" BR recalculate it.
 * - Scoped to inventory_transfer only.
 * - Enforces safety-stock-aware fulfillment: medium/low priority transfers
 *   that would breach safety_stock are rejected BEFORE source stock is modified.
 */
(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var reqSysId = current.getUniqueValue();
    var materialProduct = current.getValue('material_product');
    var sourceLocation = current.getValue('source_location');
    var destinationLocation = current.getValue('destination_location');
    var quantityRequested = parseFloat(current.getValue('quantity_requested')) || 0;
    var requestedBy = current.getValue('requested_by');
    var inventoryType = current.getValue('inventory_type');
    var requestPriority = current.getValue('priority');

    function rejectRequest(reason) {
        var req = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_req');
        if (req.get(reqSysId)) {
            req.setValue('status', 'rejected');
            req.setValue('reason', reason);
            req.update();
        }
        gs.warn('Stock transfer rejected [' + reqSysId + ']: ' + reason);
    }

    // === VALIDATION ===

    if (!sourceLocation || !destinationLocation) {
        rejectRequest('Both source and destination locations must be specified.');
        return;
    }
    if (sourceLocation === destinationLocation) {
        rejectRequest('Source and destination locations must be different.');
        return;
    }
    if (quantityRequested <= 0) {
        rejectRequest('Transfer quantity must be greater than zero.');
        return;
    }
    if (!materialProduct) {
        rejectRequest('Material/Product must be specified.');
        return;
    }

    // === FIND SOURCE STOCK ===
    var sourceStock = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock');
    sourceStock.addQuery('material_product', materialProduct);
    sourceStock.addQuery('location', sourceLocation);
    sourceStock.addQuery('active', true);
    sourceStock.query();

    if (!sourceStock.next()) {
        rejectRequest('No active inventory stock found at the source location for the requested material.');
        return;
    }

    var sourceAvailable = parseFloat(sourceStock.getValue('available_quantity')) || 0;
    if (sourceAvailable < quantityRequested) {
        rejectRequest('Insufficient available stock at source. Available: ' + sourceAvailable + ', Requested: ' + quantityRequested);
        return;
    }

    // === SAFETY STOCK CHECK (pre-deduction) ===
    var sourceSafetyStock = parseFloat(sourceStock.getValue('safety_stock')) || 0;
    if (sourceSafetyStock > 0) {
        var projectedAvailable = sourceAvailable - quantityRequested;
        if (projectedAvailable < sourceSafetyStock) {
            // Safety stock would be breached — check request priority
            if (requestPriority !== 'critical' && requestPriority !== 'high') {
                rejectRequest(
                    'Transfer would reduce source stock below safety level. ' +
                    'Projected available: ' + projectedAvailable.toFixed(2) +
                    ', Safety stock: ' + sourceSafetyStock.toFixed(2) +
                    '. Request priority is "' + requestPriority +
                    '". Only critical or high priority transfers can override. ' +
                    'Escalate priority or replenish source stock first.'
                );
                return;
            }
            // critical/high — allow; Safety Stock Monitoring flow will alert
            gs.info('Transfer [' + reqSysId + ']: Allowing safety-stock override for ' + requestPriority + ' priority request.');
        }
    }

    // === EXECUTE TRANSFER ===

    // Step A: Deduct from source total_quantity (BR recalculates available)
    var sourceTotal = parseFloat(sourceStock.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0;
    sourceStock.setValue('total_quantity', (sourceTotal - quantityRequested).toString());
    sourceStock.update();

    // Step B: Find or create destination stock
    var destStock = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock');
    destStock.addQuery('material_product', materialProduct);
    destStock.addQuery('location', destinationLocation);
    destStock.addQuery('active', true);
    destStock.query();

    if (destStock.next()) {
        var destTotal = parseFloat(destStock.getValue('total_quantity')) || 0;
        destStock.setValue('total_quantity', (destTotal + quantityRequested).toString());
        destStock.update();
    } else {
        var newStock = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_stock');
        newStock.initialize();
        newStock.setValue('material_product', materialProduct);
        newStock.setValue('location', destinationLocation);
        newStock.setValue('inventory_type', inventoryType || 'raw_materials');
        newStock.setValue('total_quantity', quantityRequested.toString());
        newStock.setValue('reserved_quantity', '0');
        newStock.setValue('safety_stock', sourceStock.getValue('safety_stock') || '0');
        newStock.setValue('reorder_level', sourceStock.getValue('reorder_level') || '0');
        newStock.setValue('status', 'available');
        newStock.setValue('active', 'true');
        var batchLot = current.getValue('related_batch_lot');
        if (batchLot) {
            newStock.setValue('batch_lot', batchLot);
        }
        newStock.insert();
    }

    // Step C: Create transfer transaction
    var txn = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_txn');
    txn.initialize();
    txn.setValue('transaction_type', 'transfer');
    txn.setValue('material_product', materialProduct);
    txn.setValue('inventory_stock', sourceStock.getUniqueValue());
    txn.setValue('quantity', quantityRequested.toString());
    txn.setValue('source_location', sourceLocation);
    txn.setValue('destination_location', destinationLocation);
    txn.setValue('requested_by', requestedBy);
    txn.setValue('status', 'completed');
    txn.setValue('transaction_date', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
    var reqBatchLot = current.getValue('related_batch_lot');
    if (reqBatchLot) {
        txn.setValue('batch_lot', reqBatchLot);
    }
    var reason = current.getValue('reason');
    if (reason) {
        txn.setValue('reason', reason);
    }
    txn.insert();

    // Step D: Complete the request
    var reqComplete = new GlideRecord('x_2056099_indust_0_inv_req');
    if (reqComplete.get(reqSysId)) {
        reqComplete.setValue('status', 'completed');
        reqComplete.setValue('completed_date', new GlideDateTime().getValue());
        reqComplete.update();
    }

    gs.info('Stock transfer completed [' + reqSysId + ']: ' + quantityRequested + ' units from ' + sourceLocation + ' to ' + destinationLocation);
})(current, previous);
]]></script>
